subject: MSP implementation certification: partner enablement program kickoff
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: James Mercer <james@cloudbridge.io>, Sara Nguyen <sara@grafana.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MSP implementation certification: partner enablement program kickoff

Hi James / Sara —

Thanks again for the conversations last week. As discussed, wed like to pilot a lightweight certification program for MSPs who will implement Redwoods observability integrations (Datadog + Grafana connectors + OTEL packaging) for joint customers. The goal is to ensure predictable deployments, reduced handoffs, and a packaged SOW we can reuse.

Attached is a first draft of the playbook (msp-cert-playbook-v1.pdf) that outlines:
- eligibility criteria and baseline technical checks (OTLP, TLS, agent configs)
- a 3-tier certification (Bronze: validation lab, Silver: live pilot, Gold: supported production)
- sample SOW and deliverables
- suggested enablement / train-the-trainer cadence (2 half-day sessions + self-study)

Open questions we'd love to align on:
1) Is Grafana comfortable with a "co-branded" certification badge for MSPs who reach Gold?
2) Any must-have legal/brand constraints from CloudBridge's side for joint marketing?
3) Target timeline: recommended 6–8 week pilot starting in March — does that fit your delivery windows?

Can we schedule a 30-minute sync next week to walk the playbook with your enablement/partner leads? Ben and Laura are cc'd to help scope commercial options and SOW templates.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

[Attachment: msp-cert-playbook-v1.pdf]
From: James Mercer <james@cloudbridge.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara@grafana.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 13:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSP implementation certification: partner enablement program kickoff

Naomi — thanks for sending, this looks promising. A couple quick clarifying items from our side: 

- Certification criteria: can you confirm whether "Gold" requires a production incident runbook handoff and 24x7 on-call capability from the MSP, or whether Redwood provides the first line of support?
- Badge usage: CloudBridge is fine with co-branding in principle; well need to share the brand guidelines with the CloudBridge marketing & legal teams.
- Timeline: March pilot is feasible but we have a major EMEA customer kickoff the week of Mar 15. Could we target the pilot start week of Mar 1 instead?

Ill loop in our enablement lead (partners@cloudbridge.io) if that helps — they can take the operational readouts. Also, I think a short SOW template would help us give a firm cost estimate.

Best,
James
Director of Solutions | CloudBridge MSP
james@cloudbridge.io

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: James Mercer <james@cloudbridge.io>, Sara Nguyen <sara@grafana.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 10:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSP implementation certification: partner enablement program kickoff

James — quick answers inline and attached a draft SOW for CloudBridge to review (cloudbridge-sow-draft.docx).

- Gold support model: Gold expects the MSP to handle L1 and L2 for infra/configuration issues, with Redwood providing an L3 escalation path (we keep the model runtime SLA). The playbook now clarifies required runbooks and a template for on-call handover.
- Branding: we are happy to follow CloudBridges brand guidelines — please share when convenient. Redwood standard co-branding terms are in the playbook appendix.
- Timeline: Mar 1 start is acceptable. Proposed pilot window: Mar 1  Apr 15 (6 weeks). Well run two enablement sessions and ask for a single live pilot customer.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm pilot start week (Mar 1) and provide primary enablement contact.
2) CloudBridge reviews SOW and returns redlines by Feb 25.
3) Ben will propose commercial options so we can finalize a simple addendum.

I've attached the SOW draft and added a checklist in the Drive link here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3C4MSPPlaybook

Thanks,
Naomi

[Attachment: cloudbridge-sow-draft.docx]
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: RE: MSP implementation certification: partner enablement program kickoff (commercial options)

Team — attaching quick commercial models below to discuss before we share with CloudBridge. High-level options:

1) Revenue-share SOW (recommended for pilot)
   - Redwood license credit: 30% off hosted API fees for certified MSP delivered projects during pilot (up to $10k credit)
   - MSP services: CloudBridge invoices customer directly for implementation + 10% referral fee to Redwood on services revenue

2) Fixed-fee certification + referral
   - One-time certification fee: $7,500 (covers enablement + assessment)
   - Referral fee: 8% of first-year services revenue after certification

3) Enterprise enablement bundle (for larger customers)
   - Annual enablement subscription: $25k (unlimited accredited engineers, quarterly refreshers)
   - Includes priority access to Redwood field engineering during pilots

Other items:
- We should keep the pilot SOW short and reversible.
- Legal: propose a lightweight addendum that references the SOW and sets a 90-day pilot term.

If Naomi & Laura are good with option 1 for the pilot, Ill draft a short commercial addendum and send to James.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
VP, Field Sales | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: James Mercer <james@cloudbridge.io>, Sara Nguyen <sara@grafana.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSP implementation certification: partner enablement program kickoff

James / Sara — thanks for reviewing. Were aligned to start the pilot the week of Mar 1. Quick confirmations and next steps: 

- Certification mechanics: Naomi will run two enablement sessions (Mar 3 and Mar 10). CloudBridge will nominate up to 3 engineers for the pilot assessment.
- Commercials: well do the Revenue-share SOW (Ben has outlined the terms) for the pilot. Ben will send the addendum for signature; were targeting DocuSign by Feb 28.
- Brand & marketing: Sara, if Grafana is ok with co-branded assets at Gold, wed like a one-slide badge image and 2-line usage guidance.

James: please send the enablement contact and any brand guidelines to partners@cloudbridge.io and cc naomi@redwood.com. Once we have a signed addendum well schedule the enablement sessions and circulate the training materials.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
